title: Ordinary constant pullback component comparison
statement:
Variables and instances are those of the attached Lean module.

theorem ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_hom_eq_constant (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A f).hom =
      (constantSinglePullbackIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f (ModuleCat.of A A)).hom
